GetApprovalDetail.description_en: Queries the action plan, risk summary, approval status, assigned approvers, and actual processing records based on an approval request ID. You can obtain the approval request ID from the approval request list returned by ListApprovals
GetApprovalDetail.description_zh: 根据审批单 ID 查询操作计划、风险摘要、审批状态、指定审批人和实际处理记录。可从 ListApprovals 返回的审批单列表中取得审批单 ID

ListApprovals.description_en: Performs a paged query for the approval summary by view, supporting paging and filtering by approval status. You can invoke GetApprovalDetail with the returned approval ID to view the operation plan and approver information
ListApprovals.description_zh: 按视图分页查询审批单摘要，可按审批状态筛选。使用返回的审批单 ID 调用 GetApprovalDetail，可查看操作计划和审批人信息

ProcessApproval.description_en: Approves, rejects, or recalls a pending approval request and returns the updated status. You can call GetApprovalDetail to view the operation plan, current status, and specified approvers
ProcessApproval.description_zh: 同意、拒绝或撤回待处理的审批单，并返回处理后的状态。可通过 GetApprovalDetail 查看操作计划、当前状态和指定审批人
